description: Searches published destination wedding venues by country, venue type, guest capacity and price range, optionally leaving out unverified imported listings. Results include descriptions, photos and listing links, with totals and pagination; summary omits descriptions and images. Unknown capacity and unverified imported price bands are null. This search does not check live availability or make bookings.

capacity_max.description: Upper end of your guest range. Matches venues with a known capacityMin no larger than this; unknown capacity is excluded.

capacity_min.description: Lower end of your guest range. Matches venues with a known capacityMax at least this large; unknown capacity is excluded.

country.description: Country name (e.g. "Italy", "Mexico"). A two-letter ISO code ("GR") or the country's own name ("Italia", "España") also works; appliedFilters.country gives the English name matched.

exclude_unverified_imports.description: Leave out unverified imported listings (descriptionStatus "unverified_import"), which carry no description and usually no capacity or price. Default false.

include_unknown_capacity.description: With capacity_min or capacity_max, also keep venues whose capacity is unknown (null) instead of leaving them out. Most imported listings have no known capacity. Default false.

offset.description: Number of results to skip; nextOffset from the previous page continues the result set.

summary.description: Return compact comparison fields without descriptions and images (default false).

name: search_venues
title: Search Wedding Venues
